---
title: "Template: Task / How-to"
description: "Task page design template — content from Invite Team"

---

<div className="nb-home">
  <div className="nb-wrap">

    <div className="nbt-crumb">
      <a href="/docs/overviews/onboarding">02 Onboarding</a>
      <span className="nbt-sep">/</span>
      <span>Set up your account</span>
      <span className="nbt-sep">/</span>
      <span>Invite Team</span>
    </div>

    <div className="nbt-hero">
      <div className="nbt-headgroup">
        <div className="nbt-title">Invite Team.</div>
        <div className="nbt-lede">Add additional users to your account.</div>
      </div>
      <div className="nbt-meta">1 step&nbsp;&nbsp;·&nbsp;&nbsp;no user limit</div>
    </div>

    <div className="nbt-narrow">

      <div className="nbt-step">
        <div className="nbt-step-head">
          <span className="nbt-step-num">01</span>
          <span className="nbt-step-title">Send the invite</span>
        </div>
        <div className="nbt-subs">
          <div className="nbt-sub"><span className="nbt-sub-num">01</span><span className="nbt-sub-text">Add the user's email</span></div>
          <div className="nbt-sub"><span className="nbt-sub-num">02</span><span className="nbt-sub-text">Click SEND INVITE</span></div>
        </div>
        <div className="nbt-chip"><span className="nbt-chip-label">No limit</span><span>Northbeam does not put a limit on the number of users in your account — add as many people as you would like.</span></div>
      </div>

      <div className="nbt-section-label">People you'll want to invite</div>
      <div className="nbt-def"><span className="nbt-def-num">01</span><span className="nbt-def-term">Ad account owners</span><span className="nbt-def-hint">e.g. Facebook Ads Manager</span></div>
      <div className="nbt-def"><span className="nbt-def-num">02</span><span className="nbt-def-term">DNS owner</span><span className="nbt-def-hint">e.g. GoDaddy, Google Domains, Cloudflare</span></div>
      <div className="nbt-def"><span className="nbt-def-num">03</span><span className="nbt-def-term">E-commerce owner</span><span className="nbt-def-hint">e.g. Shopify, BigCommerce, Woo</span></div>

      <div className="nbt-section-label">Frequently asked questions</div>
      <div className="nbt-qa">
        <div className="nbt-qa-q"><span className="nbt-def-num">01</span>Why should I invite account managers?</div>
        <div className="nbt-qa-a">Account managers are able to assist with onboarding tasks that you may be unable to complete on your own.</div>
      </div>
      <div className="nbt-qa">
        <div className="nbt-qa-q"><span className="nbt-def-num">02</span>Who should I invite?</div>
        <div className="nbt-qa-a">Any stakeholders interested in Northbeam data — ad buyers and managers, executives, and agency partners. If external partners run platform-specific advertising, add them as account managers. An engineer can help implement the pixel and the Orders API.</div>
      </div>
      <div className="nbt-qa">
        <div className="nbt-qa-q"><span className="nbt-def-num">03</span>What permissions do account managers have?</div>
        <div className="nbt-qa-a">They can add other managers, view all data, view and set connections, and perform every action the account owner can. Only the admin account manager can delete other account managers.</div>
      </div>
      <div className="nbt-qa">
        <div className="nbt-qa-q"><span className="nbt-def-num">04</span>What if the invitee doesn't receive an email?</div>
        <div className="nbt-qa-a">Check the spam folder. If it's still missing, they can generate a password through the password reset flow on dashboard.northbeam.io.</div>
      </div>

    </div>

    <div className="nbt-prevnext">
      <a className="nbt-pn" href="/docs/overviews/onboarding">
        <span className="nbt-pn-label">← Previous</span>

      </a>
      <a className="nbt-pn" href="/docs/business-information">
        <span className="nbt-pn-label">Next →</span>
        <span className="nbt-pn-title">Business Information</span>
      </a>
    </div>

  </div>
</div>
